 Khloé Kardashian issues brutal takedown of ex Lamar Odom after his ‘lame’ comments on their marriage 
 By 
 Tamantha Ryan 
 Published 
 Nov. 12, 2026, 8:15 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Khloé Kardashian slammed her ex-husband, Lamar Odom, after he made “lame” comments about their marriage in his Netflix documentary.
 “I did watch the Lamar documentary. I’m not too thrilled about it,” the reality star said in a confessional on “The Kardashians” Thursday. 
 “Because I’m watching the documentary and I’m like, wait, I took time out of my life to sit here and do a favor for you,” she added. 
 8

 8 
 Kardashian (seen above on “The Kardashians”) criticized Odom’s documentary comments, stating their bridge is now burned. Hulu

 “I’m not being paid. I’m doing this ‘cause I’m trying to be nice. There’s so many things that I just found really distasteful.”
 Kardashian, 42, said the former Los Angeles Lakers star’s comments about not really being in love with her and being married to her so he “could be more popular in pop culture” were “so weird.” 
 “Even if that is your truth, why don’t you say it without me being on the other side of these interviews? I just thought that was really, really lame,” she said.
 8 
 “There’s no more rope left to throw over. So he is dead to me,” Kardashian (seen above with Odom at the LA premiere of “Whiteout” in 2009) said. WireImage 
 8 
 “I just don’t wanna be involved. Play with yourself, don’t play with me,” the mom of two (seen above with Odom walking in the Los Angeles International Airport in 2012) added. GC Images 
 The Good American co-founder, who participated in the doc after Odom, 47, asked her to, said their bridge is now “burned.”
 “There’s no more rope left to throw over. So he is dead to me,” she said on Thursday’s episode. “This just solidifies what liars, con artists, cheats, thieves, trolls that men are. I just don’t wanna be involved. Play with yourself, don’t play with me.”
 Page Six has reached out to Odom for comment but did not immediately hear back.

 In his Netflix doc, “Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom,” which was released in March, the former NBA star claimed he only married Kardashian because of her lifestyle and connections. 
 “I’m watching how she lives and their lifestyle. I’m like, ‘This is how I want to live,'” he said in the doc.
 Odom’s daughter, Destiny, whom he shares with his childhood sweetheart, Liza Morales , said her dad did “love” Kardashian, but “had wanted to be on reality TV for a long time.” 
 8 
 Kardashian and Odom (both seen above at Kanye West’s Yeezy Season 3 show in 2016) tied the knot in 2009. Jamie McCarthy 
 8 
 Kardashian (seen above in Odom’s doc) initially filed for divorce in 2013. Netflix 
 Additionally, the two-time NBA champion claimed the “Kardashians” star wasn’t the one who helped him after his near-fatal overdose in 2015.
 Odom and Kardashian tied the knot in 2009, weeks after meeting at a party.
 In 2013, the Hulu star filed for divorce; however, she halted the split after the OnlyFans star ‘s 2015 overdose. Then, in May 2016, Kardashian refiled for divorce and it was finalized that December.
